c4Decision.commonCause: all six fail with 'the image put-checks-studio-runner:10.18a-local does not exist locally'; the tier turns a missing image into a FAILURE on purpose, never a skip
reasoning: The C4 criterion in my own D2 spec (t0-qa-20261017.md section 2.4) is '0 failed'. It is not met: 6 failed.

Two of the six are STUDIO-OBS-009 Q4 assertions about the image under test (writable /tmp; no TMPDIR or NODE_OPTIONS). The other four are the AC-4a SEC-2 browser-path checks. These are image facts of the 009 chart change, not generic noise, so the image-dependent half of AC-1/AC-4 is unproven.

The tier's authors made a missing image a failure so that nobody can read the tier as green without the image. Counting it MET with 'owed' tests would reverse that design after I saw the result, and I wrote the criterion. Only the user or @po may change an OBS-011 start condition, not me.

The cost of NOT_MET is small and mechanical: build the image, set STUDIO_RUNNER_IMAGE, re-run C4 alone (74 s in G9) at the same frozen digest. The build changes neither source nor dist, so the freeze is not disturbed [I: the build writes no repository file]. A delta addendum then flips C4 and the trigger to MET without repeating the long gate.
The 575 passing tests include every chart assertion that needs no image (no guided Deployment template, render-env subset, dump flags, PID-1 init values). They stay credited.
